title: Distributed Training Checkpointing Selection: PyTorch Async DCP vs. Megatron-Core DistCkpt vs. JAX Orbax & NVMe Burst Buffer

workload_basis.model: 405B Dense / 671B MoE (BF16 Weights + FP32 Master Weights + FP32 AdamW States)

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Naive Gather-to-Rank-0 Blocking Save (torch.save on rank==0)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Anti-pattern for multi-node training (causes Rank-0 OOM and 8-minute GPU stalls)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Synchronous Sharded DCP / Orbax Direct-to-Parallel-FS
tiers.recommended_scenario: Baseline sharded save when host RAM is constrained

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Two-Stage Pinned-RAM D2H + Background Async Flush (Async DCP / Orbax)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Standard 128-512 GPU clusters with sufficient pinned host DRAM

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Zero-Overhead CUDA Stream D2H + Local NVMe Burst Buffer + Async DCP/Orbax
tiers.recommended_scenario: Production 1,024+ GPU/TPU pre-training with frequent 15-30 min elastic checkpoints
